Object Text: The AEB feature shall be implemented as a distributed AUTOSAR application composed of seven application SWCs allocated to the AEB partition on ECU_AEB_Main: SWC_AEB_SensorFusion, SWC_AEB_RiskAssessor, SWC_AEB_Controller, SWC_AEB_BrakeActuator, SWC_AEB_SafetyMonitor, SWC_AEB_VehicleState, and SWC_AEB_HMI. The feature-level behaviour of detecting an imminent forward collision, warning the driver and requesting service braking is specified in REQ-AEB-009.
Notes: Top-level AEB feature architecture; req_type=FUNCTIONAL; UNECE R152; hardened=0.1.0; verification=review; test=TD-REQ-AEB-001

Object Text: The AEB function shall be active over the vehicle speed range 10 km/h to 60 km/h inclusive for car-to-car scenarios, per UNECE R152.
Notes: R152 speed range; req_type=FUNCTIONAL; split into 3 atomic parts; hardened=0.1.0; verification=test; test=TD-REQ-AEB-002

Object Text: When a collision is deemed imminent, the AEB Controller shall request a braking demand of at least 5.0 m/s2 to the service braking system, per UNECE R152 emergency braking requirement.
Notes: R152 minimum emergency braking demand; req_type=SAFETY; hardened=0.1.0; verification=test; test=TD-REQ-AEB-003

Object Text: The AEB feature shall provide a forward collision warning using at least two of the acoustic, haptic, and optical modalities.
Notes: R152 collision warning (>=2 modalities); req_type=FUNCTIONAL; split into 2 atomic parts; hardened=0.1.0; verification=test; test=TD-REQ-AEB-004

Object Text: A driver-initiated brake or accelerator action that exceeds the AEB braking demand shall override and cancel the AEB braking request.
Notes: Driver intent has priority; req_type=FUNCTIONAL; split into 2 atomic parts; hardened=0.1.0; verification=test; test=TD-REQ-AEB-005

Object Text: The AEB feature shall publish its availability and state (OFF, STANDBY, ACTIVE, WARNING, BRAKING, FAULT) to the gateway via provided port PP_AEBStatus with Sender-Receiver interface IF_SR_AEBStatus, updated every 10 ms.
Notes: Gateway tell-tale feed; req_type=INTERFACE; hardened=0.1.0; verification=review; test=TD-REQ-AEB-006

Object Text: On ECU startup, the AEB SWCs shall complete RAM and ROM self-tests, initialize all internal states to safe defaults (no braking demand, no warning), and remain in STANDBY until vehicle state and sensor signals are validated.
Notes: Safe-state init before any runnable runs; req_type=FUNCTIONAL; hardened=0.1.0; verification=test; test=TD-REQ-AEB-007

Object Text: Every AEB requirement shall be traceable to one software runnable, one MUD flowchart step, and one or more unit test cases.
Notes: Traceability + E2E Profile 2; req_type=CONSTRAINT; split into 2 atomic parts; hardened=0.1.0; verification=review; test=TD-REQ-AEB-008

Object Text: The AEB feature shall detect an imminent forward collision, warn the driver using at least two warning modalities, and request service braking of at least 5.0 m/s2 to avoid or mitigate the collision, in accordance with UNECE R152.
Notes: hardened=0.1.0; verification=test; test=TD-REQ-AEB-009

Object Text: SWC_AEB_SensorFusion shall execute RE_FuseObjects cyclically every 10 ms to time-align and fuse the radar object list and the camera object list into a single fused object list.
Notes: 10 ms fusion cycle; req_type=TIMING; hardened=0.1.0; verification=analysis; test=TD-REQ-AEB-101

Object Text: SWC_AEB_SensorFusion shall read RP_RadarObjects (SR IF_SR_ObjectList, up to 64 objects) via its required port.
Notes: Radar + camera object lists; req_type=INTERFACE; split into 3 atomic parts; hardened=0.1.0; verification=review; test=TD-REQ-AEB-102

Object Text: SWC_AEB_SensorFusion shall publish the fused object list via PP_FusedObjects (SR IF_SR_ObjectList, up to 128 objects) every 10 ms.
Notes: Fused object list output; req_type=INTERFACE; split into 2 atomic parts; hardened=0.1.0; verification=review; test=TD-REQ-AEB-103

Object Text: RE_FuseObjects shall time-align radar and camera objects to the current cycle using each sensor's last valid measurement timestamp and the object relative speed.
Notes: 200 ms staleness drop; req_type=FUNCTIONAL; split into 2 atomic parts; hardened=0.1.0; verification=test; test=TD-REQ-AEB-104

Object Text: RE_TrackAssociate shall associate a radar object and a camera object to the same fused track when their longitudinal distance and lateral offset each agree within 0.5 m AND their relative speed agrees within 2.0 m/s. Exactly one radar object may associate to one camera object.
Notes: Association gates 0.5 m / 2.0 m/s; req_type=FUNCTIONAL; hardened=0.1.0; verification=test; test=TD-REQ-AEB-105

Object Text: When one sensor source (radar or camera) is unavailable, RE_FuseObjects shall continue using the remaining sensor, set the source mask accordingly, and mark the fused confidence reduced.
Notes: Single-source degraded fusion; req_type=FUNCTIONAL; split into 2 atomic parts; hardened=0.1.0; verification=test; test=TD-REQ-AEB-106

Object Text: RE_FuseObjects shall reject fused objects whose longitudinal distance is negative (behind ego), whose relative speed magnitude exceeds 80 m/s, or whose existence probability is below 0.4.
Notes: Plausibility gating; req_type=SAFETY; split into 2 atomic parts; hardened=0.1.0; verification=test; test=TD-REQ-AEB-107

Object Text: RE_FuseObjects shall set a per-source timeout flag when a sensor provides no valid objects for more than 100 ms.
Notes: 100 ms per-source timeout; req_type=FUNCTIONAL; split into 2 atomic parts; hardened=0.1.0; verification=test; test=TD-REQ-AEB-108

Object Text: SWC_AEB_SensorFusion shall expose the fusion thresholds (association distance 0.5 m, association speed 2.0 m/s, drop age 200 ms, minimum probability 0.4) as calibration parameters stored in ROM.
Notes: Calibration table; req_type=CONSTRAINT; hardened=0.1.0; verification=review; test=TD-REQ-AEB-109

Object Text: RE_FuseObjects shall not allocate dynamic memory.
Notes: No dynamic memory; 2.0 ms WCET; req_type=CONSTRAINT; split into 2 atomic parts; hardened=0.1.0; verification=review; test=TD-REQ-AEB-110

Object Text: SWC_AEB_RiskAssessor shall execute RE_AssessCollisionRisk cyclically every 20 ms to compute Time-To-Collision (TTC) and collision probability for the most critical fused object in the ego lane.
Notes: 20 ms risk cycle; req_type=TIMING; hardened=0.1.0; verification=analysis; test=TD-REQ-AEB-201

Object Text: RE_AssessCollisionRisk shall compute TTC = distance / relative_speed for each fused object with positive relative speed (approaching), where distance is longitudinal range in meters and relative_speed is in m/s.
Notes: TTC = dist / rel_speed; req_type=FUNCTIONAL; split into 2 atomic parts; hardened=0.1.0; verification=test; test=TD-REQ-AEB-202

Object Text: RE_AssessCollisionRisk shall select the critical object as the fused object with the smallest valid TTC whose lateral offset places it within the ego path, using a path half-width of 1.0 m plus the object half-width.
Notes: Ego-path in-path gating; req_type=FUNCTIONAL; hardened=0.1.0; verification=test; test=TD-REQ-AEB-203

Object Text: RE_AssessCollisionRisk shall raise the FCW warning request when the critical object TTC falls to 2.6 s or below.
Notes: FCW TTC=2.6 s, release 2.9 s; req_type=SAFETY; split into 2 atomic parts; hardened=0.1.0; verification=test; test=TD-REQ-AEB-204

Object Text: RE_AssessCollisionRisk shall request partial braking (40 percent) when the critical object TTC falls to 1.6 s or below.
Notes: Partial braking TTC=1.6 s; req_type=SAFETY; split into 2 atomic parts; hardened=0.1.0; verification=test; test=TD-REQ-AEB-205

Object Text: RE_AssessCollisionRisk shall request full braking (100 percent) when the critical object TTC falls to 0.6 s or below.
Notes: Full braking TTC=0.6 s; req_type=SAFETY; split into 2 atomic parts; hardened=0.1.0; verification=test; test=TD-REQ-AEB-206

Object Text: RE_AssessCollisionRisk shall compute collision probability as a continuous value in [0,1] from the critical TTC using a piecewise-linear map: 0.0 at TTC >= 3.0 s, 0.5 at TTC = 1.6 s, and 1.0 at TTC <= 0.6 s, clipped to [0,1].
Notes: Piecewise-linear probability; req_type=FUNCTIONAL; hardened=0.1.0; verification=test; test=TD-REQ-AEB-207

Object Text: SWC_AEB_RiskAssessor shall publish PP_RiskAssessment (SR IF_SR_Risk) every 20 ms containing critical_TTC (0.01 s resolution), collision_probability (0.001 resolution), risk_level enum {NONE, WARNING, PARTIAL, FULL}, and critical_object_id.
Notes: Risk assessment output; req_type=INTERFACE; hardened=0.1.0; verification=review; test=TD-REQ-AEB-208

Object Text: RE_AssessCollisionRisk shall suppress the braking escalation (partial or full) while vehicle speed is below 10 km/h.
Notes: Pedestrian FCW below 10 km/h; req_type=FUNCTIONAL; split into 2 atomic parts; hardened=0.1.0; verification=test; test=TD-REQ-AEB-209

Object Text: SWC_AEB_Controller shall execute RE_ArbitrateBrakeDemand cyclically every 10 ms to convert the risk assessment into a deceleration demand and a braking mode.
Notes: 10 ms arbitration cycle; req_type=TIMING; hardened=0.1.0; verification=analysis; test=TD-REQ-AEB-301

Object Text: RE_ArbitrateBrakeDemand shall select the highest braking level among the driver demand, the AEB risk level, and any fail-safe request.
Notes: Max-select arbitration; req_type=FUNCTIONAL; split into 2 atomic parts; hardened=0.1.0; verification=test; test=TD-REQ-AEB-302

Object Text: RE_ArbitrateBrakeDemand shall map the risk level to a deceleration demand: NONE to 0.0 m/s2, WARNING to 0.0 m/s2 (warning only), PARTIAL to 4.0 m/s2, and FULL to 9.0 m/s2.
Notes: Demand map 0/0/4/9 m/s2; req_type=FUNCTIONAL; split into 2 atomic parts; hardened=0.1.0; verification=test; test=TD-REQ-AEB-303

Object Text: RE_ArbitrateBrakeDemand shall limit the rate of change of the commanded deceleration to 15 m/s3 using a first-order rate limiter to avoid wheel lock and occupant discomfort.
Notes: 15 m/s3 rate limit; req_type=SAFETY; split into 2 atomic parts; hardened=0.1.0; verification=test; test=TD-REQ-AEB-304

Object Text: RE_ArbitrateBrakeDemand shall cancel the AEB braking demand when the driver brake pressure exceeds the AEB-equivalent brake pressure by 10 bar.
Notes: Override 10 bar / 80 percent; req_type=SAFETY; split into 3 atomic parts; hardened=0.1.0; verification=test; test=TD-REQ-AEB-305

Object Text: RE_ArbitrateBrakeDemand shall issue a brake pre-fill command (pre-tension pads, target 5 bar) when the risk level is WARNING, so the service brake is prepared before full braking onset.
Notes: Pre-fill target 5 bar; req_type=FUNCTIONAL; hardened=0.1.0; verification=test; test=TD-REQ-AEB-306

Object Text: SWC_AEB_Controller shall publish PP_BrakeDemand (SR IF_SR_BrakeDemand) every 10 ms containing deceleration demand in m/s2 (resolution 0.01), brake mode enum {NONE, PREFILL, PARTIAL, FULL, FAILSAFE}, and a demand counter for E2E.
Notes: Brake demand output + E2E counter; req_type=INTERFACE; hardened=0.1.0; verification=review; test=TD-REQ-AEB-307

Object Text: When SWC_AEB_SafetyMonitor reports a plausibility fault, RE_ArbitrateBrakeDemand shall enter FAILSAFE mode and command a controlled braking demand of 6.0 m/s2 at vehicle speeds of 10 km/h or above, or 0.0 m/s2 below 10 km/h while FCW remains active.
Notes: Fail-safe controlled braking 6.0 m/s2; req_type=SAFETY; hardened=0.1.0; verification=test; test=TD-REQ-AEB-308

Object Text: RE_ArbitrateBrakeDemand shall increment a 16-bit demand counter on every published PP_BrakeDemand, rolling over from 0xFFFF to 0x0000 for use by the E2E protect routine.
Notes: 16-bit E2E demand counter; req_type=FUNCTIONAL; hardened=0.1.0; verification=test; test=TD-REQ-AEB-309

Object Text: RE_ArbitrateBrakeDemand shall ignore a risk assessment whose critical object is outside the ego path (lateral offset magnitude above 1.5 m) when vehicle speed is above 40 km/h, to reduce false braking on curves.
Notes: False-braking mitigation; req_type=FUNCTIONAL; hardened=0.1.0; verification=test; test=TD-REQ-AEB-310

Object Text: RE_ArbitrateBrakeDemand shall accept RP_ABSStatus (boolean) from the brake system and reduce the deceleration demand to the ABS-allowed maximum when ABS reports active wheel slip, preventing conflict between AEB and ABS.
Notes: AEB/ABS coordination; req_type=INTERFACE; hardened=0.1.0; verification=review; test=TD-REQ-AEB-311

Object Text: SWC_AEB_Controller shall expose the TTC-to-demand thresholds, deceleration rate limit 15 m/s3, override thresholds (10 bar, 80 percent), and pre-fill target 5 bar as calibration parameters stored in ROM.
Notes: Controller calibration table; req_type=CONSTRAINT; hardened=0.1.0; verification=review; test=TD-REQ-AEB-312

Object Text: SWC_AEB_BrakeActuator shall execute RE_CommandBrake cyclically every 5 ms to convert the deceleration demand into a brake pressure command and apply it via the brake booster.
Notes: 5 ms actuation cycle; req_type=TIMING; hardened=0.1.0; verification=analysis; test=TD-REQ-AEB-401

Object Text: RE_CommandBrake shall convert the deceleration demand to a target brake pressure using P_target = decel_demand * K_veh_mass / K_brake_gain, where K_veh_mass is the calibrated vehicle mass (kg) and K_brake_gain is the calibrated deceleration-per-bar gain (m/s2 per bar).
Notes: Decel-to-pressure map; req_type=FUNCTIONAL; hardened=0.1.0; verification=test; test=TD-REQ-AEB-402

Object Text: RE_CommandBrake shall ramp the commanded brake pressure toward P_target at a maximum rate of 200 bar/s on application and 300 bar/s on release to avoid pressure spikes.
Notes: Apply 200 bar/s, release 300 bar/s; req_type=FUNCTIONAL; hardened=0.1.0; verification=test; test=TD-REQ-AEB-403

Object Text: RE_CommandBrake shall read back the achieved brake pressure via RP_BrakePressureFeedback and compare it to the commanded value.
Notes: 15 bar / 50 ms deviation; req_type=SAFETY; split into 2 atomic parts; hardened=0.1.0; verification=test; test=TD-REQ-AEB-404

Object Text: SWC_AEB_BrakeActuator shall publish PP_BrakePressure (SR IF_SR_Pressure) every 5 ms containing the commanded brake pressure (bar, resolution 0.1) and a status flag indicating actuation health.
Notes: Pressure command output; req_type=INTERFACE; hardened=0.1.0; verification=review; test=TD-REQ-AEB-405

Object Text: On initialization and whenever no braking demand is active, RE_CommandBrake shall command 0 bar (no braking) and set the actuation status to IDLE.
Notes: Safe default 0 bar; req_type=SAFETY; hardened=0.1.0; verification=test; test=TD-REQ-AEB-406

Object Text: RE_CommandBrake shall clamp the commanded brake pressure to the range [0, P_MAX], where P_MAX = 250 bar.
Notes: Clamp [0, 250] bar, deadband 1 bar; req_type=FUNCTIONAL; split into 2 atomic parts; hardened=0.1.0; verification=test; test=TD-REQ-AEB-407

Object Text: SWC_AEB_BrakeActuator shall expose K_veh_mass, K_brake_gain, ramp rates (200 bar/s apply, 300 bar/s release), deviation threshold 15 bar, and P_MAX 250 bar as calibration parameters stored in ROM.
Notes: Actuator calibration table; req_type=CONSTRAINT; hardened=0.1.0; verification=review; test=TD-REQ-AEB-408

Object Text: SWC_AEB_SafetyMonitor shall execute RE_MonitorSafety cyclically every 5 ms to perform plausibility checks, E2E verification, watchdog triggering, and degraded-mode management.
Notes: 5 ms monitor cycle; req_type=TIMING; hardened=0.1.0; verification=analysis; test=TD-REQ-AEB-501

Object Text: RE_MonitorSafety shall compare the fused critical object's longitudinal distance and relative speed against the raw radar measurement every 5 ms.
Notes: 1.0 m / 3.0 m/s, 3 cycles; req_type=SAFETY; split into 2 atomic parts; hardened=0.1.0; verification=test; test=TD-REQ-AEB-502

Object Text: RE_MonitorSafety shall verify the E2E Profile 2 protection on all safety-relevant input signals (RP_RadarObjects, RP_CameraObjects, RP_VehicleSpeed, RP_YawRate).
Notes: E2E Profile 2, 2 consecutive failures; req_type=SAFETY; split into 2 atomic parts; hardened=0.1.0; verification=test; test=TD-REQ-AEB-503

Object Text: RE_MonitorSafety shall trigger the hardware watchdog via Rte_Call every 5 ms.
Notes: HW watchdog 5 ms; req_type=SAFETY; split into 2 atomic parts; hardened=0.1.0; verification=test; test=TD-REQ-AEB-504

Object Text: RE_MonitorSafety shall transition the AEB feature to DEGRADED mode (braking limited to 4.0 m/s2, warning disabled) when a single sensor source fails, and to FAILSAFE mode (controlled braking 6.0 m/s2) when both sources fail or an actuation fault is present.
Notes: Degrade 4.0 m/s2, failsafe 6.0 m/s2; req_type=SAFETY; hardened=0.1.0; verification=test; test=TD-REQ-AEB-505

Object Text: RE_MonitorSafety shall report every detected fault to DEM via Dem_ReportErrorStatus and store the fault snapshot (fault code, TTC, vehicle speed, timestamp) in NVM via NvM_WriteBlock(NvM_AEB_FaultLog).
Notes: DEM + NvM fault log; req_type=FUNCTIONAL; hardened=0.1.0; verification=test; test=TD-REQ-AEB-506

Object Text: SWC_AEB_SafetyMonitor shall publish PP_SafetyStatus (SR IF_SR_Safety) every 5 ms containing the AEB mode enum, an active fault bitmask, and E2E verification status per source.
Notes: Safety status output; req_type=INTERFACE; hardened=0.1.0; verification=review; test=TD-REQ-AEB-507

Object Text: RE_MonitorSafety shall perform RAM checksum and ROM CRC-32 self-tests at startup.
Notes: RAM/ROM self-test; req_type=SAFETY; split into 2 atomic parts; hardened=0.1.0; verification=test; test=TD-REQ-AEB-508

Object Text: SWC_AEB_SafetyMonitor shall expose plausibility thresholds (1.0 m, 3.0 m/s, 3 cycles), E2E failure count 2, and the degrade and derate levels as calibration parameters stored in ROM.
Notes: Monitor calibration table; req_type=CONSTRAINT; hardened=0.1.0; verification=review; test=TD-REQ-AEB-509

Object Text: SWC_AEB_VehicleState shall execute RE_UpdateEgoMotion cyclically every 10 ms to update ego vehicle speed, longitudinal acceleration, yaw rate, and steering angle from vehicle sensors.
Notes: 10 ms ego-motion cycle; req_type=TIMING; hardened=0.1.0; verification=analysis; test=TD-REQ-AEB-601

Object Text: SWC_AEB_VehicleState shall read RP_VehicleSpeed (SR IF_SR_Speed, range 0-350 km/h, resolution 0.01 km/h, 10 ms cycle) and RP_WheelSpeedFL, RP_WheelSpeedFR, RP_WheelSpeedRL, RP_WheelSpeedRR (four wheel speeds) via required ports.
Notes: Speed + 4 wheel speeds; req_type=INTERFACE; hardened=0.1.0; verification=review; test=TD-REQ-AEB-602

Object Text: RE_UpdateEgoMotion shall validate RP_VehicleSpeed against the four wheel speeds.
Notes: 3 km/h / 100 ms validation; req_type=FUNCTIONAL; split into 2 atomic parts; hardened=0.1.0; verification=test; test=TD-REQ-AEB-603

Object Text: SWC_AEB_VehicleState shall read RP_YawRate (range -100 to +100 deg/s, resolution 0.01 deg/s) and RP_SteeringAngle (range -720 to +720 deg, resolution 0.1 deg) for ego-path estimation.
Notes: Yaw + steering for path; req_type=INTERFACE; hardened=0.1.0; verification=review; test=TD-REQ-AEB-604

Object Text: SWC_AEB_VehicleState shall publish PP_VehicleState (SR IF_SR_EgoState) every 10 ms containing vehicle speed, longitudinal acceleration, yaw rate, steering angle, and a signal-validity bitmask.
Notes: Ego state output; req_type=INTERFACE; hardened=0.1.0; verification=review; test=TD-REQ-AEB-605

Object Text: RE_UpdateEgoMotion shall set the standstill flag when vehicle speed is below 0.5 km/h for more than 200 ms, and clear it when speed exceeds 1.0 km/h (hysteresis).
Notes: Standstill hysteresis; req_type=FUNCTIONAL; hardened=0.1.0; verification=test; test=TD-REQ-AEB-606

Object Text: SWC_AEB_HMI shall drive the forward collision warning to the instrument cluster via PP_HMIWarning (SR IF_SR_HMI) containing the warning level enum {NONE, VISUAL, VISUAL_ACOUSTIC, VISUAL_HAPTIC}.
Notes: HMI warning output; req_type=INTERFACE; hardened=0.1.0; verification=review; test=TD-REQ-AEB-701

Object Text: RE_UpdateWarning shall activate at least two warning modalities (visual plus acoustic, or visual plus haptic) whenever the FCW warning request is active, satisfying the UNECE R152 collision warning requirement.
Notes: R152 multi-modal warning; req_type=FUNCTIONAL; hardened=0.1.0; verification=test; test=TD-REQ-AEB-702

Object Text: RE_UpdateWarning shall update the cluster warning state on a DataReceivedEvent of PP_RiskAssessment.
Notes: 500 ms clear; req_type=FUNCTIONAL; split into 2 atomic parts; hardened=0.1.0; verification=test; test=TD-REQ-AEB-703

Object Text: SWC_AEB_HMI shall relay the AEB availability and fault status to the cluster for the tell-tale lamp, updated every 100 ms, using PP_AEBStatus.
Notes: Tell-tale lamp feed; req_type=INTERFACE; hardened=0.1.0; verification=review; test=TD-REQ-AEB-704

Object Text: When one sensor source (radar or camera) is unavailable, the AEB feature shall continue with the remaining source in single-source degraded mode, raise a sensor-source fault within 100 ms, and transition to FAILSAFE mode as specified in REQ-AEB-505 when both sources are unavailable.
Notes: hardened=0.1.0; verification=test; test=TD-REQ-AEB-801

Object Text: The AEB feature shall transition from DEGRADED or FAILSAFE mode back to STANDBY only after the triggering fault is no longer present and the recovery criteria in the safety analysis are satisfied.
Notes: split into 2 atomic parts; hardened=0.1.0; verification=test; test=TD-REQ-AEB-802

Object Text: On an E2E Profile 2 counter mismatch or CRC failure on a safety-relevant input, the AEB feature shall raise the corresponding fault after two consecutive failures, enter DEGRADED mode within 10 ms of the second failure, and report and persist the fault to DEM and NVM.
Notes: hardened=0.1.0; verification=test; test=TD-REQ-AEB-803

Object Text: When the commanded brake pressure deviates from the feedback pressure by more than 15 bar for more than 50 ms, the AEB feature shall report a brake actuation fault to SWC_AEB_SafetyMonitor.
Notes: split into 2 atomic parts; hardened=0.1.0; verification=test; test=TD-REQ-AEB-804

Object Text: When ABS reports active wheel slip, the AEB deceleration demand shall not exceed the ABS-allowed maximum.
Notes: split into 2 atomic parts; hardened=0.1.0; verification=test; test=TD-REQ-AEB-805

Object Text: When the FCW warning request is active, the AEB feature shall activate at least two warning modalities, clear the warning within 500 ms after the risk level returns to NONE, and ensure a higher-priority warning is not masked by a lower-priority one.
Notes: hardened=0.1.0; verification=test; test=TD-REQ-AEB-806

Object Text: On ECU startup, the AEB feature shall initialize all outputs to the safe state (no braking demand, no warning) and remain in STANDBY until RAM/ROM self-tests and signal validation pass.
Notes: split into 2 atomic parts; hardened=0.1.0; verification=test; test=TD-REQ-AEB-807

Object Text: A healable AEB fault shall be cleared only after the DEM healing criterion is satisfied with no recurrence of the triggering condition.
Notes: split into 2 atomic parts; hardened=0.1.0; verification=test; test=TD-REQ-AEB-808

Object Text: At startup and after a calibration update, the AEB feature shall verify that every safety-relevant calibration parameter is within its declared minimum/maximum range and that its default/current value is consistent with the vehicle variant.
Notes: split into 2 atomic parts; hardened=0.1.0; verification=test; test=TD-REQ-AEB-809

Object Text: The AEB feature shall only accept authenticated and integrity-protected software and calibration updates, prevent activation on a failed authenticity or integrity check, and record a fault.
Notes: hardened=0.1.0; verification=review; test=TD-REQ-AEB-810

Object Text: The AEB feature shall select its speed range, vehicle mass, brake gain and warning modalities from a validated vehicle-variant configuration.
Notes: split into 2 atomic parts; hardened=0.1.0; verification=review; test=TD-REQ-AEB-811

Object Text: Each AEB runnable shall complete within its allocated WCET budget on ECU_AEB_Main: RE_CommandBrake and RE_MonitorSafety within 5 ms, RE_FuseObjects and RE_ArbitrateBrakeDemand and RE_UpdateEgoMotion within 10 ms, RE_AssessCollisionRisk within 20 ms.

Object Text: The AEB feature shall expose test hooks to inject sensor loss, E2E failure, brake-feedback deviation, ABS-active and plausibility faults.
Notes: split into 2 atomic parts; hardened=0.1.0; verification=review; test=TD-REQ-AEB-813
